blockingIssues.description: The overdue one-shot launch gap is fixed, but live-reschedule protection still falls back to stale DB status when supervisor runtime inspection is unavailable. `get_stream_status()` collapses `SUPERVISOR_UNAVAILABLE`/`PERMISSION_DENIED` back to the persisted row, so `update_stream_schedule()` can still accept a future schedule for an actually live stream if the DB status is stale `stopped`.

appliedUpdates.description: Documented the local runner unhealthy-state caused by stale supervisor program configs pointing at missing host log directories in `.factory/library/environment.md` so validators can recognize it as a bootstrap cleanup issue.

rejectedObservations.observation: Mission/shared-state docs still do not mention that DEV auth falls back to a built-in default identity when `DEV_USER_EMAIL` and `DEV_USER_ID` are unset, so workers keep rediscovering the effective local auth identity during API verification.
